title: Personalities & Moods — Aula 28

expressions.meaning: Não estou com vontade / no clima.
expressions.example: Don't ask me to go out — I'm not in the mood tonight.

expressions.expr: She's on top of the world.
expressions.meaning: Ela está nas nuvens / feliz demais.
expressions.example: She got the promotion — she's on top of the world right now.
He keeps interrupting me — he's driving me crazy!
With all these deadlines, I'm really feeling under pressure.

sentences: She is very patient with her students.
I felt anxious before the job interview.
They acted very confident during the presentation.
She expressed how excited she was about the trip.
I feel overwhelmed with so much work.
He is quite stubborn — he never changes his mind.
She seemed relieved when the meeting ended.
I feel a little nervous about the meeting.
He acted extremely confident in the interview.
She is incredibly empathetic with her team.
They seem pessimistic about the results.

grammar.title: Aula 28 — 3 Estruturas para Descrever Pessoas
rules: TO BE + adjetivo → personalidade permanente: "She is very patient." / "He is outgoing."
TO FEEL / SEEM + adjetivo → estado temporário: "I feel anxious today." / "He seems tired."
TO ACT + adjetivo → comportamento em situação: "She acted confident." / "Don't act so impulsive!"
Intensificadores (grau): a little → quite → really → very → extremely → incredibly

quiz.q: I ___ very anxious before the exam. (feel — past)
"He never changes his mind." → He is very ___.
They ___ really excited during the presentation. (act — past)

"He makes decisions too fast." → He is very ___.
